description: Reads one game: its settings (engine, description, visibility, sound direction), its entities (the things that make noise, like the player or an enemy) with how many of their events already have a chosen sound, and the inbox (scenes the engine plugin sent that are not placed yet). Returns the site link (url) of the game and of each entity. Read-only, costs nothing. Use it after list_games to see what is inside a game. For an entity's events and versions use get_entity; for folders and folder events, list_folders; for what is still missing, game_progress.

game_id.description: The game id, from list_games or create_game.

name: get_game
